policy.source_content: This registry records candidate references, visible publisher/archive metadata, exact locators inspected, and access/rights status. It is not an anatomy dataset and contains no copied muscle claims or source tables.
policy.access_is_not_permission: A freely viewable page or downloadable file does not automatically authorize copying, adaptation, redistribution, or inclusion in an application. Record the license for the exact edition/file and its attribution separately from access.
policy.claim_provenance: Future anatomy and assessment statements require source ID, exact edition, claim-level page/table/figure locator, access date, and an independent evidence/review state. Do not turn a citation to a general chapter into evidence for an unlocated claim.
policy.files_not_obtained: A web page, file listing, or external link being visible is not recorded as a file download. Unless a row says otherwise, no source files were downloaded into this project and no checksum exists.
policy.asset_gate: Do not import an asset into a public build or redistribute it unless the exact source file, release, license, required credit, modifications, and hashes are recorded and the license permits that use.

sources.organization: Federative International Programme on Anatomical Terminologies (FIPAT), International Federation of Associations of Anatomists (IFAA)
sources.edition: Second edition; published online in 2019 and approved by the IFAA General Assembly
sources.edition_status: publisher_metadata_verified; official Part 2 PDF indexed with partial table rows; binary not locally acquired
sources.verified_locator_detail: IFAA identifies TA2 as the approved second edition published online in 2019. The official FIPAT-hosted Part 2 PDF search index exposed selected exact row and printed-page snippets; captured ranges are listed in work/evidence/T04/source-access.md and work/evidence/T04/source-locator-register.json. The PDF binary was not acquired or visually reviewed, so no full table, frozen file hash, or complete muscle list is claimed.

license.note: IFAA states web-published terminologies are CC BY-ND 4.0. sources.access_state: IFAA metadata and publication page viewed; official Part 2 PDF search-index excerpts viewed for selected rows/pages; PDF binary not downloaded; official errata link identified but not exhaustively checked
sources.artifact_state: no original local copy or source hash; 85 partial row locators structured in the T04 catalog; full list and table-column verification incomplete
sources.intended_use_candidate: International Latin/English terminology concept crosswalk and catalog baseline candidate; not the sole source for Korean/Hanja terms, muscle attachments, assessment procedures, or anatomy claims.
limitations: FIPAT distinguishes official terms, equivalents, synonyms, related terms, and candidate terms; preserve these categories rather than flattening them.
The online terminology environment may be revised; retain a dated edition/revision and exact row locator when T04 acquires a usable list.
Search-index excerpts are partial and do not replace a local visual audit of the exact fixed source PDF.
Official/equivalent/synonym cell roles and all applicable errata need visual cross-check before term promotion.
The partial excerpt set does not support a whole-body denominator or absence claims for unextracted regions.

sources.artifact_state: no_local_copy; no_hash; several relevant section locators recorded

decisions_for_t01: Use FIPAT TA2 as the international nomenclature candidate, but wait until T04 to freeze the actual catalog after exact item lists and locators are available.
Treat Korean Anatomical Terminology 6th edition (2014) as a candidate trace, not a confirmed current source; verify the primary source/latest edition before entering terms.
Use OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e only as an educational cross-check candidate; record the exact claim locator and its CC BY-NC-SA terms if any content is later reused.
Use the Merck Manual page as a general assessment evidence candidate only; no copied text, per-muscle protocol, diagnosis rule, or treatment rule is authorized.

For T02, use only exact LSDB Archive files whose source and license are recorded. The archive's 2025 notice states CC BY 4.0 and a required credit; do not assume that notice applies to live API outputs or other dataset copies.
Do not count the OpenSim model's muscle or force-element rows as canonical muscle concepts.
